## DEC-7 — AddressDropdown Hyvä migration: chọn Strategy B (full Hyvä-native)

- **Date**: 2026-07-16 (Accepted 2026-07-16)
- **Status**: Accepted — approved via `/approve` by user acting as SA/TL decision authority (Level 2)
- **Decided option**: Strategy B (full Hyvä-native — Alpine.js + Magewire + `.phtml` + Tailwind v4)
- **Deciders**: user (chat) acting as SA/TL authority — formal SA/TL name [TBD]
- **Context**: Ticket [TASK-88NDV5](../../tickets/TASK-88NDV5-apply-hyva-theme-addressdropdown.md) yêu cầu apply Hyvä cho `Secomm_AddressDropdown`. Module hiện là Luma/Knockout/RequireJS thuần → không render trên storefront Hyvä. OSC (checkout thật) là Knockout-based chạy qua compat `hyva-themes/magento2-luma-checkout`. Có 2 strategy:
  - (A) Storefront rewrite sang Hyvä + giữ Knockout trong checkout-region qua compat layer, chỉ sửa OSC component target.
  - (B) **Full Hyvä-native** (Alpine.js + Magewire + `.phtml` + Tailwind v4) cho **mọi address surface incl. OSC**.
- **Decision**: Chọn **Strategy B** — render hierarchical VN address dropdown Hyvä-native trên cả customer address form, cart estimation, và Mageplaza OSC (shipping + billing). Backend (`Api/`/`Model`/`Setup`/import/admin) giữ nguyên; tái dùng GraphQL sẵn có (`GetListCity`/`GetListSubCity`) + core Magento GraphQL (Country/Region).
- **Rationale**: Nhất quán hoàn toàn với theme Hyvä (BR-001/BR-002), tránh phụ thuộc dài hạn vào compat layer luma-checkout (kỹ thuật trung gian, dễ vỡ khi upgrade), giảm bề mặt Knockout/RequireJS trên storefront. Magewire là preferred cho stateful form (address dropdown) theo AGENTS.md §7.2.
- **Consequences**:
  - (+) Frontend nhất quán Hyvä; dễ maintain; không phụ thuộc compat layer.
  - (−) Effort cao hơn (estimate ~32–56h vs ~16–24h cho A); chạm OSC (Tier 2) nhiều hơn → rủi ro checkout/payment regression.
  - (−) Phải giải OSC address seam + submit mechanism (Open Questions Q2/Q3 trong spec).
  - Follow-up: đánh giá undeprecate + cache GraphQL resolver (Q1); QC end-to-end checkout + payment bắt buộc.
- **Related**: [TASK-88NDV5](../../tickets/TASK-88NDV5-apply-hyva-theme-addressdropdown.md) · [spec addressdropdown-hyva](../../specs/addressdropdown-hyva.md) · `project-context/10_CHECKOUT_PAYMENT_SHIPPING_ORDER_FLOW.md` · AGENTS.md §7.2, §12 (high-risk)

## DEC-8 — Reusability boundary: Secomm_AddressDropdown (module) vs Launchpad (project) — refine DEC-7

- **Date**: 2026-07-16 (Accepted 2026-07-16)
- **Status**: Accepted — approved via `/approve` by user acting as SA/TL decision authority (Level 2)
- **Decided option**: module owns generic surfaces only (no OSC/Ahamave coupling); OSC integration → Launchpad package (TASK-FMAN1B)
- **Deciders**: user (chat) acting as SA/TL authority — formal SA/TL name [TBD]
- **Context**: `Secomm_AddressDropdown` là module **tái dụng (reusable)**. DEC-7 (Strategy B) ban đầu gộp cả OSC integration vào module — vi phạm nguyên tắc tách biệt: module tái dụng không được coupling với `Mageplaza OSC` (third-party, choice theo project) hay `Secomm_Ahamave` (project-specific shipping). Thực tế `view/frontend/requirejs-config.js` đang reference `Secomm_Ahamave/...` = **project-leak** vào module tái dụng.
- **Decision**:
  - **Module (`Secomm_AddressDropdown`)** chỉ sở hữu **generic Magento-native surfaces**: customer address form, cart shipping estimation, default/Luma checkout. Module có thể hỗ trợ Hyvä (template Tailwind/Alpine/Magewire của chính nó) vì Hyvä là theme, không phải third-party.
  - **OSC customization** (wiring address dropdown vào Mageplaza OSC) phải nằm trong **package Launchpad** (project layer: `app/design/frontend/Secomm/launchpad/` + code project-owned) → **ticket riêng TASK-FMAN1B**.
  - Module **không reference** `Mageplaza_Osc` hay `Secomm_Ahamave`. Remove dead ref Ahamave hiện có.
- **Rationale**: Giữ module tái dụng portable (deploy cho client khác không có OSC/Ahamove vẫn chạy surface generic); tách concern reusable vs project-specific; OSC là decision của project này (BR-004), không phải dependency của module.
- **Consequences**:
  - (+) Module sạch, tái dụng được; OSC risk (Tier 2 checkout/payment) cô lập trong TASK-FMAN1B/Launchpad.
  - (−) Work split thành 2 ticket: TASK-88NDV5 (module) + TASK-FMAN1B (Launchpad OSC); TASK-FMAN1B phụ thuộc TASK-88NDV5 (module phải expose Hyvä component/dữ liệu để Launchpad wire vào OSC).
  - Refines DEC-7: phần "render dropdown trên OSC" trong DEC-7 không do module làm — chuyển sang TASK-FMAN1B (Launchpad). DEC-7 (Strategy B — Hyvä-native) vẫn valid cho cả 2 ticket.
- **Related**: refines [DEC-7](#dec-7) · [TASK-88NDV5](../../tickets/TASK-88NDV5-apply-hyva-theme-addressdropdown.md) · [TASK-FMAN1B](../../tickets/TASK-FMAN1B-launchpad-osc-address-integration.md) · [spec addressdropdown-hyva](../../specs/addressdropdown-hyva.md)

## DEC-9 — Dual-theme support (Luma + Hyva) cho reusable module — refines DEC-7

- **Date**: 2026-07-17
- **Status**: Accepted — user-directed (approved plan)
- **Decided option**: module theme-agnostic (both Luma native + Hyva native); theme switch qua `hyva_` layout handle
- **Deciders**: user (chat) acting as SA/TL authority — formal SA/TL name [TBD]
- **Context**: DEC-7 (Strategy B) hướng tới Hyvä-native; TASK-88NDV5 implement rewrite customer form **Hyva-only** + xóa Luma JS (`address-dropdown.js`, cart mixin) → **Luma bị hỏng**. Nhưng `Secomm_AddressDropdown` là module **reusable generic** (DEC-8) → phải hỗ trợ BOTH Luma (native jQuery/Knockout) VÀ Hyva (native Alpine) để ship cho client project trên mỗi stack.
- **Decision**:
  - Module **theme-agnostic** — hỗ trợ cả Luma + Hyva trên toàn bộ storefront (customer form + cart + default checkout).
  - Templates nằm trong **module** (portable). Customer form theme switch qua **`hyva_` layout handle** (Hyva auto-add qua `Hyva\Theme\Observer\AddLayoutHandles`): `customer_address_form.xml` (Luma, `setTemplate → edit.phtml`) + `hyva_customer_address_form.xml` (Hyva, `setTemplate → hyva/address/edit.phtml`), cả hai `ifconfig="address/general/enable"`.
  - Cart: Luma layout (`checkout_cart_index.xml` Knockout jsLayout) **inert trên Hyva** (php-cart native, region-based). Default checkout: Luma layout (`checkout_index_index.xml`) inert trên Hyva/OSC.
  - **Không PHP theme detection** — bỏ Block preference + `Block\Customer\Address\Edit` + `Helper\Theme` (core block `getTemplate` trả layout-set template).
- **Rationale**: `hyva_` handle = pattern Hyva khuyên dùng (declarative, zero-PHP, FPC-safe). Portable — không hard-depend `Hyva_Theme` (module chạy trên Luma-only client). `ifconfig` trên `<action>` gate module-enable (locked bởi Magento `BlockTest.php`). Module ship được cho client Luma hoặc Hyva.
- **Consequences**:
  - (+) Module reusable, cả 2 theme native; cơ chế sạch (layout handle, không PHP detection).
  - (−) Luma path **không test được** trên project Hyva-only này → QC cần Luma theme/client riêng.
  - Refines DEC-7: "Hyva-native" → "dual Luma + Hyva". DEC-8 (boundary generic/OSC) vẫn valid.
  - Follow-up: default-checkout Luma JS VN-hardcoding (`shipping-address-dropdown.js:160-170`) → align i18n (riêng).
- **Related**: refines [DEC-7](#dec-7) · [DEC-8](#dec-8) · [TASK-88NDV5](../../tickets/TASK-88NDV5-apply-hyva-theme-addressdropdown.md) · [spec addressdropdown-hyva](../../specs/addressdropdown-hyva.md) · plan `v-i-secomm-addressdropdown-y-l-merry-parrot.md`

- [DEC-TASK9Q5ZAK-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASK9Q5ZAK-001.md) — Physical shipment facts layer: ShippingCore owns carrier-neutral facts (`Api/Physical/` PhysicalPackage/ShipmentPhysicalData/CarrierPhysicalLimit — grams/cm int, facts-only, không carrier semantics); storage = `sales_shipment.packages` marker `secomm_physical` (Magento-native, 0 bảng mới, label-flow mutually exclusive); merchant default dims = `secomm_shippingcore/physical/*` PREFILL-only (di chuyển khỏi `carriers/secomm_ghn/parcel_*`, không bao giờ auto-inject — thiếu final data fail-closed INVALID_PARCEL); GHN interpret: 1 pkg <20,000g → type 2 root, else type 5 items[] = 1 GHN item/physical package ("Package N", qty 1, exact values), root weight = Σ factual, dims = largest-by-volume; multi-package = 1 Shipment → N pkg → 1 GHN order; limits carrier-owned 50,000g/200cm; RATE type-5 giữ backlog (option A — checkout chưa có confirmed physical facts) **[STALE — type-5 RATE items[] đã implement bởi TASK-WAWNDS; >50kg giờ pre-validated INTEGRATION_LIMITATION theo DEC-TASKMQ2DRG-001 2026-09-23]** (proposed 2026-09-15 — TL accept tại r2 review; work_items: TASK-9Q5ZAK)

- [DEC-TASKWY6WP5-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKWY6WP5-001.md) — Shipping Coverage target abstraction: `CoverageTargetRegistry` (DI opt-in `{type, code, label}`, thiếu type → CARRIER) thay `CarrierRegistry`; P1 chỉ CARRIER, METHOD reserved; registration ≠ persisted coverage (không config → runtime defaults ALL); `PolicyConfig` → `CarrierCoverageConfigAdapter` (paths `carriers/<code>/*` byte-identical, DEFAULT scope, hasExplicitConfig any-scope); IA `Secomm → Shipping → [Shipping Zones, Shipping Coverage]` (amend placement flat của DEC-FEATQA23PZ-001 §5 — user chốt 2026-09-23), ACL ids + routes ổn định; zone form geography-only (bỏ assigned_carriers, giữ CarrierZoneIndex/ZoneReferenceGuard); selector rebuild core ui-select + xoá searchable-multiselect component; lifecycle Add/Configure/Edit/Reset (Reset xoá 4 rows DEFAULT + scoped warning); GHTK không register; METHOD runtime/inheritance chỉ document (accepted 2026-09-23 — TL directive + user approval 2 điểm; work_items: FEAT-QA23PZ, TASK-WY6WP5)
- [DEC-TASKDFGFZ9-002](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKDFGFZ9-002.md) — COD amount decision ownership → Secomm_Cod: contract `CodCollectionResolverInterface::resolve(Order, Shipment, ?Prior)` → decision VO (COLLECTIBLE|NOT_COD|REJECTED + amount + currency + reason; prior opaque `getProviderShipmentReference()` — caller owns identity, resolver owns policy, contract không hardcode single-shipment); P1 policy `SingleCollectionCodResolver`: thu MỘT lần/order bằng grand_total theo order currency, prior khác shipment → REJECT, ≠VND → REJECT (no conversion), partial shipment → REJECT, non-COD không bao giờ bị chặn, KHÔNG allocation framework; retry freeze: GHN anchor cod_amount persisted-wins, GHTK anchor table mới `secomm_ghtk_shipment` (partner_code UNIQUE, insertPending trước POST, frozen replay, retry vẫn POST + ORDER_ID_EXIST); xoá Ghtk CodAmountResolverInterface/DefaultCodAmountResolver (seam duy nhất là Secomm_Cod resolver); GHN consume Secomm_Cod (sequence +=, đảo ngược forbidden edge Rev v11) + builder luôn emit cod_amount (0 = non-COD; cap 50M fail-closed) + outcome COD_REJECTED (observer comment visible, không anchor không POST); partial supersede DEC-SL016-001 items 4-5 + DEC-TASKDFGFZ9-001 consequence "amount carrier-owned" (accepted 2026-09-23 — user acting as SA/TL, plan approval + 2 AskUserQuestion; work_items: TASK-DFGFZ9)

- [DEC-TASKMQ2DRG-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKMQ2DRG-001.md) — GHN RATE pre-validation weight matrix: unit >50kg → UNAVAILABLE `GHN_PACKAGE_WEIGHT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (hard, không fallback); total >50kg mọi unit hợp lệ → UNAVAILABLE `RATE_REQUEST_UNREPRESENTABLE` (shared mới) → INTEGRATION_LIMITATION fallback theo RateSourceMode; ≤50kg giữ type 2/5 items[] flow; **supersede TASK-WAWNDS ">50kg aggregate NOT rejected at RATE"** (sandbox fact fee-API-tolerance giữ làm history; quote >50kg giờ là business NO); ShippingCore amendment tối thiểu TL-approved (constant + policy map + outcomeDrivenEligibility branch — materialize §35.5 capability-unsupported row, NO v11); thresholds centralize `GhnShipmentConstraints`; dimension pre-validation DEFERRED (gap: không có attribute source có unit contract) (accepted 2026-09-23 — TL directive + user approval 2 điểm; work_items: TASK-MQ2DRG, FEAT-FQWEQ3)
- [DEC-TASKDFGFZ9-004](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKDFGFZ9-004.md) — Phase 3 closure: atomic per-order claim engine-enforced (`secomm_cod_collection.active_order_claim` nullable + UNIQUE — INSERT-first recordPending, `CodClaimConflictException` khi attempt khác giữ claim; FAILED releases / UNKNOWN keeps); currency gate → carrier adapters (GHTK LocalizedException / GHN COD_REJECTED — trước recordPending/POST, không convert); zero-amount COD giữ classification (collectible 0.0; âm → REJECTED invalid_order_amount); claim-release fixes (GHTK arm-after-map; GHN 3 pre-POST fail sites → FAILED); integration proof 2 PDO connections cạnh tranh thật gồm transaction-blocked variant (partial supersede DEC-003; accepted 2026-09-23 — user acting as SA/TL; work_items: TASK-DFGFZ9)
- [DEC-TASKRT50KH-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKRT50KH-001.md) — Product shipping dimension contract P1: **reuse** length/width/height qua delete+recreate (audit: 0/176 products có giá trị — empty shells; decimal/GLOBAL/labels "(cm)"/validate-number+zero-or-greater/merchandising flags off; migration patch add-only + FK cascade dọn set rows); reader `Secomm\Base\Api\ShippingDimensionsReaderInterface` (product-data owner; configurable→child qua getChildren[0], bundle ship-together→parent, downloadable=Virtual subtype skip sẵn); **completeness-only-authoritative** (cả 3 present+numeric+>0 → ceil int cm; else null=missing không rejection); dims CHỈ cho GHN hard-limit gate 150cm (RATE_MAX_SIDE_CM SANDBOX_OBSERVED) — fee payload vẫn omit; hard violation → GHN_PACKAGE_{L|W|H}_LIMIT_EXCEEDED không fallback; **150 de-dup correction** (MQ2DRG silent replace failure — grep gap lesson) (accepted 2026-09-23 — TL directive + user approval Option A; work_items: TASK-RT50KH, FEAT-FQWEQ3)
- [DEC-TASK5YGKME-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASK5YGKME-001.md) — PICK_PRIMARY auto-first: không có curated primary (is_primary=1, hiện 0 dòng) → selector chọn candidate ĐẦU theo code sort (deterministic) thay vì fail-closed NO_DESIGNATED_PRIMARY; curated 1 primary vẫn thắng; MULTIPLE_PRIMARY vẫn fail-closed; constant NO_DESIGNATED_PRIMARY giữ BC (default impl không còn trả về); supersede DEC-FEATYA2C0W-006 amendment "never first-candidate" (chỉ điểm đó); lý do: mọi ward 2025 là merger multi-edge → fail-closed = GHN không bao giờ price trên checkout thực (93+ UNRESOLVED log); trade-off user-accepted: fee xấp xỉ theo 1 vùng giao cũ cho ward merger (accepted 2026-09-25 — user directive "tự chọn 1 cái, lấy top cho nhanh" + plan approval; work_items: TASK-5YGKME)
- [DEC-TASK3ZEB25-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASK3ZEB25-001.md) — PICK_PRIMARY candidate selection semantics FROZEN: 0 candidate fail-closed (NOT_APPLICABLE → handoff UNRESOLVED); 1 candidate select SOLE ngay không inspect is_primary (fast path trước DB, SOLE_CANDIDATE); >1 + đúng 1 primary → primary (CURATED_PRIMARY); >1 + 0/multiple primary → deterministic first (code sort ASC, enforce 1 chỗ trong selector — cấm raw DB order/mapping_id priority) với reason DETERMINISTIC_FIRST_{NO_PRIMARY,MULTIPLE_PRIMARY}; multiple primary KHÔNG fail rate flow — chỉ diagnostic `MULTIPLE_PRIMARY_CANDIDATES` (logger.warning, payload không PII); provenance getSelectionReason() trên selection VO (4 REASON_* constants, SELECTED require reason); provider mapping không influence selection + không retry cascade (GHN mapping fail → PROVIDER_MAPPING_MISSING, không thử candidate khác); STRICT/FALLBACK không đổi; NO_DESIGNATED_PRIMARY/MULTIPLE_PRIMARY constants giữ BC (default impl không còn trả về); supersede DEC-TASK5YGKME-001 ở 2 điểm (multiple-primary fail-closed; count=1 NOT_APPLICABLE) (accepted 2026-09-25 — TL directive 30 section "Audit & Align PICK_PRIMARY Candidate Selection Semantics" + plan approval; work_items: TASK-3ZEB25)
- [DEC-TASKZS2B41-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKZS2B41-001.md) — GHN dimension limits merchant-tunable qua System Config PER-DIMENSION SHARED (rev. 2026-10-01 user correction #2, pre-review — supersedes bản 6-path/150-RATE của 2026-09-30): `carriers/secomm_ghn/max_{length,width,height}_cm` (3 paths DÙNG CHUNG RATE + CREATE, defaults 200×3 Create contract DOCUMENTED; sandbox 150 SANDBOX_OBSERVED 2026-09-18 supersede làm default — merchant hạ config khi account enforce 150); `GhnShipmentConstraints::MAX_SIDE_CM = 200` là authoritative default/fallback duy nhất (RATE_MAX_SIDE_CM xoá; Config::readPositiveIntCm fallback khi empty/≤0 — hard limit không bao giờ bị vô hiệu); single read seam Model\Config `getMaxLengthCm/getMaxWidthCm/getMaxHeightCm(?int $storeId)`; RATE qua QuoteParcelEstimator→QuoteParcelEstimate 3 optional params (BC), CREATE qua GhnPhysicalLimit inject Config (interpreter/ViewModel tự theo; đọc scope-null — giới hạn interface, documented); CREATE per-dimension FIX — interpreter so mỗi chiều với OWN limit (code cũ so mọi chiều với length limit), message "%2 limit" thay "per-side limit"; weight 20/50kg GIỮ contract constants (out of scope); supersedes ghi chú FROZEN "reuse consts" của TASK-RT50KH/MQ2DRG ở khía cạnh dimension (accepted 2026-10-01 — TL directive 2026-09-30 + user decision + plan approval; work_items: TASK-ZS2B41)
- [DEC-TASKW5BW4F-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKW5BW4F-001.md) — GHN create-failure surfacing 2 lớp: (1) pre-commit block cho lỗi deterministic — fresh save (entity_id chưa cấp) trên `secomm_ghn_*` qua `sales_order_shipment_save_before` + `GhnCreateParcelValidator` shared với creation service (row usability + per-package limits single source; re-save shipment hiện hữu không bao giờ bị chặn) → 0 shipment/anchor/snapshot rác, defuse persist-before-interpret; (2) loud post-commit cho mọi lỗi còn lại — PENDING-first + idempotency `GHNS<shipment_id>` giữ nguyên, outcome non-SUCCESS → admin error message + shipment comment qua `GhnCreateOutcomeNotifier`; bề mặt section "GHN Shipment" read-only trên shipment view (provider row + snapshot packages), core modal giữ BUG-74VGQX; alternatives bị loại: full sync pre-commit (đổi idempotency key order-derived + GHN outage khoá ops) và auto-hủy shipment (state-machine risk); CANONICAL_UNRESOLVED → lớp 2, follow-up E-B/E-C; retry admin button = follow-up (accepted 2026-09-30 — user decision 3 vòng AskUserQuestion, TL gate tại review; work_items: TASK-W5BW4F)
- [DEC-TASKS52DGA-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKS52DGA-001.md) — Generic Offline Shipment P1: offline save = REUSE core Save POST + `shipment[fulfillment_mode]=OFFLINE` (không controller mới, ACL native `Magento_Sales::ship`, hidden input JS-armed + confirm + uncheck label); metadata = marker JSON `secomm_fulfillment` trên `sales_shipment.packages` (user chọn marker thay bảng — zero migration, pattern secomm_physical, PackagingBlockPlugin strip thêm); eligibility frozen `{INVALID_PARCEL, INVALID_CONFIGURATION}` (transient + address-class không eligible); nút luôn hiện khi carrier capable qua `CarrierOfflineCapabilityInterface` pool (GhnOfflineCapability đăng ký secomm_ghn; non-capable intent reject fail-closed); gating: GhnShipmentCreateObserver skip khi request intent OR persisted metadata OFFLINE (C1 — commit_after fire mọi save, re-save comment/track không được gọi GHN), ShippingCore commit_after observer in-flight guard (C2), raw-prefix carrier resolve (C4); COD offline = 0 call Secomm_Cod (gap manual-collection báo cáo không fix); retry không guard theo task §15 (hazard retry-CLI-on-offline documented, P2 CLI notice); alternatives loại: dedicated controller+ACL, bảng riêng, session-only button visibility (accepted 2026-09-30 — user decisions 4 AskUserQuestion + plan approval, TL gate tại review; work_items: TASK-S52DGA)

- [DEC-TASKFXFMJ0-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKFXFMJ0-001.md) — GHN RATE weight flow: gỡ 50kg pre-gate (supersede DEC-TASKMQ2DRG-001 ở khía cạnh RATE): Calculate Fee KHÔNG có 50kg threshold (DOCUMENTED developer.ghn.dev 2026-09-30 + SANDBOX_OBSERVED matrix 12/12 — single 50.001/60kg, aggregate 70/120kg đều quote 200); weight chỉ chọn service_type 2/5 qua biên 20kg; CREATE 50kg cap giữ nguyên (interpreter enforce); fallback: heavy weight đơn thuần không tạo eligibility (SUCCESS→realtime, timeout→TECHNICAL như cũ); RATE_REQUEST_UNREPRESENTABLE → RESERVED (GHN là emitter duy nhất, không emitter nữa, wiring giữ); dims policy + items[] per-unit serialization KHÔNG đổi; gate mở theo §7 của brief TASK-FXFMJ0 **[REVISED một phần 2026-10-01 bởi DEC-TASKWNQCRW-001 — weight gate quay lại dạng display filter tunable + type flip]** (accepted 2026-09-30 — TL gate tại review; work_items: TASK-FXFMJ0)
- [DEC-TASKWNQCRW-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKWNQCRW-001.md) — GHN RATE weight semantics FROZEN (supersede DEC-TASKFXFMJ0-001 ở 2 khía cạnh: "no RATE weight cap" + "type rule giữ nguyên"; fallback rule FXFMJ0 GIỮ): (1) RATE service_type_id = TOTAL quote weight ONLY — `<20000g→2, >=20000g→5`, CẤM packageCount/itemCount ảnh hưởng (bỏ `packageCount===1` của TASK-WAWNDS; payload type 2 multi-package an toàn — items[] guard theo type); (2) per-unit weight gate MERCHANT-TUNABLE `carriers/secomm_ghn/max_package_weight_g` (GRAMS, store scope, default 50000 = TYPE_5_MAX_WEIGHT_G, fallback const, strictly >) — 1 unit > limit → UNAVAILABLE `GHN_PACKAGE_WEIGHT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` trước fee call, không fallback, weight check trước dims trong findHardLimitViolation; (3) aggregate KHÔNG cap khi mọi unit ≤ limit (70/120kg sandbox evidence giữ); (4) RATE ≠ CREATE truth — RATE type transient không persist/reuse, CREATE derive độc lập từ PhysicalPackages, constraints frozen (provenance TÁCH 4 nguồn: 20kg fee contract / >50kg CREATE capability làm eligibility guard / aggregate sandbox-observed / CREATE interpretation = Create contract); RATE_REQUEST_UNREPRESENTABLE giữ RESERVED (accepted 2026-10-01 — TL brief frozen rules + user decision config default 50000g + plan approval; work_items: TASK-WNQCRW)
